title: McDonald's Japan Only Menu Special Tsukimi Edition
description:
Get 10% off (save up to $44!) your own authentic Japanese snack box from Bokksu using my link: https://bit.ly/2yBK3Le and code PAOLO10

Japan McDonald's limited menu.  The Mcdonald's Tsukimi Egg menu items are back this time of year perfect for moon viewing season.  I eat the McDonald's fried egg burgers, red bean mochi pies, shaka shaka fries and even a spicy chicken burger.  These McDonald's Japan only menu items usually are held this time of year to align with Tsukimi Moon viewing season.  This only in Japan McDonald's menu is only available for a limited time.  I know that many people aren't able to visit to Japan at the moment so I wanted to share what type of McDonald's Japan limited menu items are being offered right now.  I love when McDonald's Japan special menu items are offered because I find it so unique and fun to try.  I hope you enjoy this McDonald's food tour in Japan.
